secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Direct model provider key (OpenAI by default). Optional for browsing; required before agents can answer. Get it from your provider's API keys page.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_URL
secrets.description: Optional OmniRoute model-transport origin, if you use one instead of a direct provider key.

secrets.name: OMNIROUTE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional OmniRoute inference key, used together with OMNIROUTE_URL.
